description: GET ONLY the 'Premium' field of TitlePublicConfigurationModel. Premium offerings catalogue — paid subscriptions, premium passes, real-money bundle skus, supporter tiers. Distinct from Store (regular in-game shop with virtual-currency prices) and from DealOffer (limited-time promotional offers). Use this specifically for monetization tiers / IAP that grant ongoing benefits.
